title: Chosen to Shine
story:
A teacher gave every student a small candle during a classroom activity.

She turned off the lights, and the room became completely dark.

Then she lit one candle.

Its gentle light began to brighten the room.

Soon every student lit their candle from the first one.

Within moments, the classroom was filled with light.

The teacher smiled and said,

“One small light can make a great difference in the darkness.”

God has chosen His people for a special purpose.

He has called us out of darkness into His wonderful light.

Our lives are meant to reflect His goodness so that others may come to know Him.

When we live with kindness, faith, and love, we shine as lights that point others to Christ.
life_lesson: God has chosen you to belong to Him and to shine His light in a dark world.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for choosing me to be Your own.

Thank You for calling me out of darkness into Your wonderful light.

Help me to reflect Your love, kindness, and truth wherever I go.

May my life point others to Jesus and bring glory to Your name.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
How has God brought light into your life?

In what ways can you shine His light to your family, friends, or community today?

Who needs to see God's love through your actions?
verse: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession, that you may declare the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His wonderful light.
